convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'MultiStochastic_Exp' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Multi-symbol resonance logic across 3 currency pairs per slot adds complexity. The custom indicator's buffer values (300 sentinel) must be understood to replicate in Python.

derived_values.name: MinBars minimum bar count for data sufficiency

other_exits: UpStop buffer==300 triggers BuyPositionClose (closes long when custom indicator signals stop)
DnStop buffer==300 triggers SellPositionClose (closes short when custom indicator signals stop)

custom_logic_notes: Multi-symbol resonance strategy: each slot monitors 3 correlated pairs (SymbolA, SymbolB, SymbolC) via a custom MultiStochastic_Exp indicator that synthesizes stochastic signals across all 3 symbols. Entry signals use sentinel value 300 from indicator buffers. SynchroCheck ensures all 3 symbols' bar timestamps align before signal evaluation. 3 independent trade slots (0/1/2) each with their own symbol triad and parameters. SL is clamped to broker's stoplevel if below it. PositionSelect prevents duplicate positions per symbol. Previous bar [1] values are read for signal detection (completed bar logic).
python_conversion_notes: The MultiStochastic_Exp custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - it is the core signal generator. The resonance logic across 3 symbols per slot is non-trivial and requires synchronized bar data. The sentinel value 300 check (buffer==300) is unusual and must be faithfully replicated. SynchroCheck (bar time alignment across 3 symbols) must be preserved. Each slot's indicator handle is created on SymbolA with SymbolB/SymbolC passed as parameters. The 3-slot architecture allows parallel independent trading on EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD. FOK filling may cause frequent rejections in backtesting - consider IOC fallback. StopLoss=500 with no TakeProfit means exits are purely indicator-driven via UpStop/DnStop signals.
